reviews.text: We arrived at the store at 7:59pm exactly, on the net it says they’re open until 9pm but apparently they close at 8pm. We asked if we could purchase just 5 goldfish but were denied as they are closed.

silly place with a bunch of silly workers. nice fishes nd cool live plants, seemed chill
